decided: When a project signs off once per program, the user is asked to sign the program brief after the program's closing architecture review, at the point where every stage is archived and that review is recorded, and the program is not done until they sign. Under one pull request per program, the step that marks that pull request ready is shown only once they have signed. No stage's completion waits for the sign-off.
alternatives: ask before the last stage is marked complete, as first decided, so the signed brief would not include the closing review
ask before the last stage is marked complete and let records written later leave the signature standing
why: The closing review and its follow-up come after the last stage is marked complete and add to the program brief, so asking earlier would have the user sign a brief the program's own review had not yet looked at, and under one pull request per program ask them twice.
